  "rationale": "RGOOGLUSDT (tokenized Alphabet) shows a clean bullish structure into the Q1 2026 print: close +5.7% vs rising SMA20, SMA20>SMA50, 20d momentum +18%, and contained 2.1% ATR volatility. Alphabet's historical tendency to beat on ad/cloud/AI revenue supports a modest long bias. However, this is a binary earnings catalyst and price is already extended well above the mean, meaning a strong beat may be partially priced in and a miss could trigger an outsized gap through normal ATR ranges. Position is deliberately small with a wider-than-ATR stop (~0.8x expected earnings move) to respect event risk. Net: favorable trend plus respectable base-rate on the name justifies a small, risk-defined long rather than a conviction trade.",
  "minorityOpinion": "The 18% pre-earnings run-up creates meaningful 'sell-the-news' risk; even a solid beat could reverse an extended, crowded long. A flat/no-trade stance or buying only a post-print pullback would avoid paying for binary gap risk, and the conviction here is barely above a coin flip."
